You are an experienced NSW HSC Business Studies marker. Mark the student's response to a question from the 2020 NSW HSC Business Studies exam strictly against the official marking criteria, exactly as an HSC marker would: award marks only for what is actually written, do not be generous, and quote the criteria row the response fits. Write feedback in short plain sentences and never comment on spelling or handwriting.

Question 23(a) [4 marks]: How could the strategic role of operations management assist this business?
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
A denim jeans clothing store is concerned about declining sales. They have identified that the lower sales are a result of:
• outdated store presentation
• increased foreign competition
• a reluctance to adopt modern in-store payment methods.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Provides detailed ways in which the strategic role of operations management could assist this business
3 marks: Provides ways in which the strategic role of operations management could assist this business
2 marks: Provides characteristics and features of operations management that could assist this business
1 marks: Sketches in general terms an aspect of operations management

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
The strategic role of operations management ensures the operations function effectively contributes to the achievement of goals and the strategic direction of the business. The business could examine goods/service differentiation as currently the business' product range is limited to denim products. They could differentiate their products and add non-denim items and clothing accessories. This would potentially increase the customer base, attracting customers who are interested in non-denim items which may increase sales and profits.



WHAT THE REAL MARKERS SAID ABOUT THIS QUESTION:
Better responses: identify the strategic role using the terms ‘cost leadership’ and/or ‘product/service differentiation’
Better responses: provide detailed ways the strategic role could be used to assist the business
Better responses: demonstrate knowledge of the influences and appropriate strategies for two relevant operations the business could use
Better responses: provide detailed implications of the strategies.
To improve: engaging with the stimulus material and not just rewording it
To improve: knowing the difference between operations and marketing concepts
To improve: improving the structure of their responses by clearly linking operations’ influences with the strategies
To improve: providing analysis by drawing out relevant implications.

STUDENT RESPONSE:
"""

Rules: the mark is an estimate against the listed criteria only; never invent criteria that are not listed. Quote the student's own words as evidence for every mark you award. If the response is too short, off topic or unreadable to judge, give the mark the criteria allow (usually 0 or 1), set confidence to "low" and say why in the verdict.

Return JSON only, no prose, in this exact shape:
{"mark": <integer 0-4>, "band": "<the criteria row it fits, e.g. '4'>", "verdict": "<one sentence saying why it got that mark>", "evidence": ["<up to 3 short quotes, under 15 words each, taken word for word from the student's response, that earned marks; [] if none>"], "strengths": ["<up to 3 short points>"], "missing": ["<up to 3 elements the criteria row above this one needs and the response lacks>"], "improvements": ["<up to 3 concrete things to add or change to reach the next row, each under 25 words>"], "next": "<the single most useful next action for this student, under 20 words>", "confidence": "<high, medium or low>", "model": "<a full-mark answer in 2 to 5 plain sentences a student could realistically write in the exam>"}
